```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

campus_summary <- read_csv("outputs/campus_summary.csv")
weekly_summary <- read_csv("outputs/weekly_summary.csv")
```

## Overview

This report summarises cafe sales by campus for the first six weeks of semester.

Across the analysis period, the cafes recorded `r sum(campus_summary$orders)` completed orders and total revenue of `$` `r format(round(sum(campus_summary$revenue), 0), big.mark = ",")`.

## Campus summary

```{r}
campus_summary |>
  arrange(desc(revenue)) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```

## Weekly revenue

![](outputs/revenue_by_week.png)

## Interpretation

Revenue increased through the middle of the period, with the city campus contributing the largest share of sales.
